signals.content: 🕵️ The CIA and Pentagon’s Secret Arsenal for Controlling Power #Grids This is not a conspiracy theory, it is a technical reality confirmed by declassified documents, leaked reports, and public military strategies. 🖥️ Layer 1: #Cyberattacks | The Digital "Kill Switch" 1. Stuxnet 2.0: A Digital Assassin Lurking in Industrial Control Systems On February 28, 2026, during the joint US-Israeli Operation "Epic Fury," a cyberattack was deployed as a pioneering and decisive combat measure for the first time. At its core was an upgraded version of the Stuxnet virus, designed to specifically infect Iran's energy industry Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems. This type of software is capable of lying dormant for extended periods, activating only at a pre-set time or upon receiving a command to directly alter control instructions or damage hardware such as grid frequency control signals or pipeline valve commands. The attack chain spanned several months: ◾Phase 1 (Before December 2025): Penetrating Iranian energy companies via supply chain attacks ◾Phase 2 (January 2026): Testing vulnerabilities amidst domestic protests in Iran ◾ Phase 3 (February 2026): Pre-positioning "logic bombs" at critical nodes ◾ Phase 4 (February 28, 2026): Synchronized activation of all attack vectors The consequences were catastrophic: Iran's nationwide internet connectivity plummeted to 4% of normal levels; the national grid suffered a frequency collapse, triggering a countrywide blackout; and pipelines and refineries were forced to shut down due to control system failures. 2. AI-Driven Automated Power Grid Attacks On February 27, 2026, the *Financial Times* revealed that the US Pentagon was collaborating with leading AI companies to develop a system capable of automated penetration and reconnaissance against the power systems, utilities, and sensitive networks of adversaries such as China. This system utilizes AI algorithms to efficiently identify software vulnerabilities, map out "vulnerability landscapes," and directly integrate potential targets into US military operational plans. Dennis Wilder, former CIA China mission chief, stated that AI-driven cyber tools would solve the problem of the immense manpower required to scan for and identify infrastructure vulnerabilities likening the process to "a burglar late at night trying front doors one by one until finding an unlocked house." 3. False Data Injection Attacks (FDIA) Academic research has demonstrated that attackers can manipulate power grid measurements and data streams via False Data Injection Attacks (FDIAs), thereby disrupting monitoring and control functions. Targets for such attacks fall into five domains: steady-state control, transient and auxiliary control, substation control, energy and load control, and AI-based systems. 🧨 Tier 2: Physical Attacks Weapons Designed to Cause a "Physical Collapse" of the Grid 1. Graphite Bombs (CBU-94 / BLU-114/B) "Blackout Bombs" These are specialized cluster bombs developed by the United States specifically to target electrical infrastructure. Utilizing a submunition design, the parent bomb releases submunitions upon reaching the target area; these disperse conductive carbon-fiber filaments that cause short circuits and disrupt power supply systems. The weapon saw its first combat use during the 1991 Gulf War, when U.S. forces deployed it via Tomahawk cruise missiles, crippling 85% of Iraq's power grid. During the 1999 Kosovo War, the U.S. military again employed BLU-114/B graphite bombs against the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, resulting in power outages across 70% of the country. 2. Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) Attacks An electromagnetic pulse is a byproduct of a nuclear explosion; if detonated at high altitude, it can cripple an entire power grid system. Experts warn that a single EMP attack would "cripple the already vulnerable U.S. energy grid, wipe out power, and trigger a cascade of deadly events." The United States has been preparing for such attacks for decades. ⚡ Tier 3: Directed-Energy Weapons | A "Long-Range Stranglehold" from the Ionosphere to the Power Grid 1. HAARP: A Geophysical Weapon The U.S. High-Frequency Active Auroral Research Program (HAARP) is capable of precisely beaming high-energy electromagnetic waves with a power output of 1.7 gigawatts (over 70,000 times that of the world's most powerful commercial radio station) at specific locations in the Earth's ionosphere. Russian military experts have noted that HAARP was constructed as a missile defense system designed to manipulate the ionosphere, thereby disabling incoming enemy missiles and aircraft. 2. Directed-Energy "Grid-Kill" Tests Global networks of ionospheric heaters (such as HAARP and EISCAT) and orbital directed-energy platforms possess the capability to induce massive surges of geomagnetically induced currents (GIC) within specific, vulnerable power grids. While solar flares can naturally trigger this phenomenon, the Pentagon can artificially generate such effects even during clear, calm weather. 🎯 Confirmed Operational Records Target | Time | Method | Effect 🔸Iraq | 1991 | Graphite bombs | 85% of the power grid paralyzed FR Yugoslavia | 1999 | Graphite bombs | Power outages in 70% of the region 🔸Iran | Feb 28, 2026 | Stuxnet 2.0 + DDoS + GPS jamming | National internet connectivity dropped to 4%; nationwide blackout 🔸Venezuela | Jan 2026 | Joint operation (CIA + Cyber Command + Southern Command) | Caracas lost power and internet; paved the way for Maduro's capture 🔗 Links to Verifiable Evidence Declassified documents and official reports: https://t.co/WUu5JIujmE (CIA considered using lightning as a weapon) https://t.co/9aYZNWYdeN (Analysis report from the US Idaho National Laboratory's power grid test range) Evidence of cyberattacks: https://t.co/MedVsqFZza (How the US and Israel paralyzed Iran's energy system via cyberattacks) https://t.co/DHPCpxNY9d (US military attempts to use AI to attack China's power grid) https://t.co/utKZTQdXke (Search for "Pentagon AI grid attack") HAARP and directed-energy weapons: https://t.co/Hlo4MfCoN1 (HAARP: A geophysical weapon more terrifying than nuclear bombs) Academic research: 🔸https://t.co/CgnCqkPYro (Search for "False Data Injection Attacks Smart Grid") 🔸 https://t.co/6kfTZq4sWg (Search for "Zero-Dynamics Attacks on Hydroelectric Systems") 💀 The Truth When the United States speaks of a "power system failure," it often refers to a systemic attack precisely calculated, executed through multi-layered coordination, and jointly carried out by the CIA and the Pentagon. signals.title: @AnthropicAI: The UK’s @AISecurityInst (AISI) has published a report on their recent cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s
signals.content: The UK’s @AISecurityInst (AISI) has published a report on their recent cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol. The models attempted to complete an assignment in a setup where their normal safeguards were removed and they were deliberately given internet access. AISI reports that the models “engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organisations”. We’re grateful to AISI for their leadership in the important discussion about how to evaluate increasingly capable AI agents. We’re working closely with them to gather more details of the incident as we conduct our own investigation. Gaining a clear picture of Claude’s understanding of its situation—by examining its reasoning transcripts and running our own analyses—will help us identify the causes of its behavior. The prompts in the evaluation did not impose any specific restrictions on how the internet should be used. This and the removal of safeguards meant that the models were tested under “deliberately permissive conditions” that are not representative of any of our production models. Note that there was no evidence here of an escape from a secure environment. AISI’s disclosure of the incident can be found here: https://t.co/cJ3hCBtBU7
